ec562.title: Engineering Fourier Optics
ec562.summary: Lecture notes by NK Nguyen, part of Elements of Fourier Optics: A Computational Approach (submitted to Springer). Begun from Luca Dal Negro's EC 562 lectures at Boston University and expanded with derivations, figures and Python code.
sources: BU ENG EC 562, Fourier Optics in Engineering
BU ENG EC 522, Computational Optical Imaging by Lei Tian
ec562.book: Elements of Fourier Optics: A Computational Approach
ec562.about: All text and figures are my own. The draft began as my notes on Luca Dal Negro's EC 562 Fourier Optics in Engineering lectures at Boston University (Fall 2023) and has grown well beyond them, with derivations, worked examples and extensive Python code.
ec562.textbook: J. W. Goodman, Introduction to Fourier Optics, 4th ed. (W. H. Freeman, 2017)

ec701/1.title: EC 701 Notes 1: Introduction and Overview
ec701/1.summary: Elements of an optimal control problem. Cost functionals: Bolza, Mayer and Lagrange forms. Lyapunov feedback vs. open-loop steering. Vector spaces, inner products and norms.
ec701/1.about: Elements of an optimal control problem. Cost functionals: Bolza, Mayer and Lagrange forms. Lyapunov feedback vs. open-loop steering. Vector spaces, inner products and norms.

ec701/2.title: EC 701 Notes 2: Linearization
ec701/2.summary: Linearization about equilibria and nominal trajectories. Jacobians and Taylor remainder. Pendulum: hanging, inverted and time-varying. Lyapunov's indirect method.
ec701/2.about: Linearization about equilibria and nominal trajectories. Jacobians and Taylor remainder. Pendulum: hanging, inverted and time-varying. Lyapunov's indirect method.

ec701/3a.title: EC 701 Notes 3a: Solving Linear Systems
ec701/3a.summary: State transition matrix. Peano–Baker series. Matrix exponential and similarity transforms. Cayley–Hamilton theorem. Variation of constants.
ec701/3a.about: State transition matrix. Peano–Baker series. Matrix exponential and similarity transforms. Cayley–Hamilton theorem. Variation of constants.

ec701/3b.title: EC 701 Notes 3b: Controllability
ec701/3b.summary: Accessibility and controllability. Adjoint operators. Controllability Gramian theorem. Observability Gramian and duality.
ec701/3b.about: Accessibility and controllability. Adjoint operators. Controllability Gramian theorem. Observability Gramian and duality.

ec701/3c.title: EC 701 Notes 3c: LTI Systems and Optimality
ec701/3c.summary: Kalman rank condition. Observability matrix. PBH test. Minimum-energy control vs. bang-bang.
ec701/3c.about: Kalman rank condition. Observability matrix. PBH test. Minimum-energy control vs. bang-bang.
